ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High. Dominant high-intensity white/cream core region (~85%) bordered by low-intensity black trailing and leading edge boundaries (~15%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous yellowish-tan mottling patches on the lateral-upper sections of both lobes. Distinct black pigmentation localized at the median notch vertex and along the entire trailing edge perimeter. Circular high-intensity white focal spots are distributed across the mid-lobe surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a central vertex; approximately 40-45 degree angle relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying amplitudes. Visible peaks and valleys along the entire upper boundary, with increased complexity near the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the trailing edge towards the tips; visible leading edge segments display a convex curve towards the water line.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, light-colored pixel clusters identified as barnacle scars. Dense cluster of ~8-10 units on the distal-right lobe; scattered units on the left lobe including a central-lateral cluster of three.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions. Notable diagonal mark on the mid-left lobe and two short vertical marks on the upper-right lobe near the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive textured, high-relief bio-fouling (barnacle colonies) localized at both the extreme left and right distal tips of the fluke.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellowish-tan pigmentation patches present on both lobes, exhibiting a distinct color transition from the primary white ventral surface.
